notes: 'of his' renders the מִמֶּנּוּ phrase; the preposition takes 'of' and the suffix the possessive 'his'.
'them' in 'brought them to Damascus' is added: the Hebrew verb carries no object morpheme.
The waw of וַיַּךְ takes the relative 'who' under rule 17, no explicit subject pronoun standing in the recast clause.
